ChainWitness
Hardware-signed authenticity in a world of AI-generated content.
Solana Mobile Hackathon 2026 · Built on Solana
The problem
Seeing is no longer believing
A fake takes seconds
Modern image generators produce photorealistic fakes faster than most people can check them.
Metadata proves nothing
EXIF data is invisible to viewers and stripped by almost every app a photo passes through.
No way to check
A viewer has no independent way to confirm when — or whether — a photo was really taken.
ChainWitness
02
The idea
A wallet that witnesses the moment
ChainWitness has your phone's camera and your own Solana wallet co-sign every photo, in the seconds right after the shutter closes — no gallery uploads, no later edits, nothing to fake after the fact.
How it works
From shutter to chain, in one motion
1
Capture
In-app camera only — no gallery picker
2
Hash
SHA-256, computed right on the phone
3
Sign & send
Your own wallet signs it, via Mobile Wallet Adapter
4
On-chain
Hash + timestamp, published as a Solana memo tx
5
Verified
Backend independently re-checks it against devnet
Every step but the last happens in the seconds after you press the shutter — the on-chain transaction is signed and broadcast before you ever leave the capture screen.
ChainWitness
04
Real network usage
No backend ever holds a key
The wallet signs and sends it — not us
Every proof transaction is signed and broadcast by the user's own wallet, direct to Solana.
The backend only checks its work
It independently re-verifies each transaction against devnet — it never just trusts the client.
The proof survives us
If every one of our servers vanished tomorrow, every proof already on-chain would still check out.

07
Honesty, on purpose
What this actually proves
What's guaranteed
  • The hash matches the exact bytes captured
  • That wallet's key signed it — nothing else could
  • The signature landed on-chain at that timestamp
  • A backend independently re-checked all of it
What we don't claim
  • That the camera wasn't pointed at a screen
  • That the scene itself wasn't staged
  • "Unfakeable" — a word we never use
Proof of wallet, content and time — a real, narrower guarantee, honestly stated, is worth more than a bigger claim we can't back up.
ChainWitness

What's next
Devnet was step one, not the ceiling
Mainnet
Same code, different cluster — the architecture never assumed devnet.
Surface hardware-backed signing
Show, not just assume, when a proof came from Seed Vault specifically.
A deeper social loop
More ways to react to a moment than a tip — without diluting the proof itself.
Public re-verification logic
It's small enough to audit. We want it open, not just "trust our server."
